Qazi Touqeer's Bigg Boss 20 Status Clarified Amid Health Rumors

Speculation arose regarding singer Qazi Touqeer's participation in Bigg Boss 20 due to reported health issues. His team clarified that he has not been eliminated from the show. Touqeer experienced fever for several days and felt a significant drop in energy, leading to him being taken to the medical room for examination by a doctor. While recovering from fever, rumors circulated about his potential exit from the house.
